$description: Apollo Ecosystem Modular Registry Map — breaks the monolith apollo-registry.json into a chaptered SSOT. Lossless: rebuilding every chapter in load_order reproduces the monolith exactly.

$adjustments_from_base_v1.plugin_count: Base listed 42 plugin files; the monolith holds 45. Added apollo-calendar, apollo-classifieds, apollo-shortcodes.
$adjustments_from_base_v1.nested_vs_top_level: Base named FORBIDDEN_CONCEPTS, skeleton_structure_file, routes_registry_file, integration_map_file, data_flow, audit_verificator, development_guidelines, security_audit, remediations, last_full_technical_audit, ecosystem_hook_spine, nav_header_v6, layers, total_plugins as top-level keys. They are all NESTED inside their parents ($philosophy, $header, $apollo_rule, $audit, $GLOBAL_ARCHITECTURE, cdn, architecture) and are owned via the parent.
$adjustments_from_base_v1.keys_not_present: MASTER_REGISTRY (exists as architecture.master_registry), js_data_contract, js_modules_map, PluginInventorySync — not present in the monolith; dropped rather than invented.
$adjustments_from_base_v1.deep_audit_split: coupling_edges/high_risk_plugins (10) and open_rest_total/remediations_applied (11) live inside $deep_audit, not at top level. $deep_audit is split four ways across 04-audit, 04-audit-reports, 10-coupling, 11-security and deep-merged back on build.
$adjustments_from_base_v1.orphan_chapters_added: Base covered no chapter for roles, timeDisplay, namingRules, constants, summary, quick_lookup, divergences, $routing_canonical, $mu_plugins, $third_party_plugins, $to_be_done. Chapters 14-17 were added so the split is lossless.
$adjustments_from_base_v1.chapter_added_18: 18-canvas-shell records the Blank Canvas Apollo / Apollo+ migration completed 2026-07-28.

02-header.note: Also carries the four root scalars ($schema/$version/$generated/$description).

04-audit-reports.note: Carved out of 04-audit: 39 per-plugin deep-audit reports.

21-mockup-field-contract.note: Register-before-build queue: every node the dj/local single-page mockups print that no registered key can supply, plus four 01-philosophy violations that must NOT be given storage.

22-mu-plugins.note: The MU boot layer: 15 files that run before active_plugins and cannot be disabled from wp-admin. Carved out of 14-routing, which documented only 5.

validations: every chapter file in load_order exists and parses
no two chapters own the same top-level key (except the declared $deep_audit split)

$known_divergences: 6 registry entries have no plugin folder on disk (flagged in chapters['09-plugins'].absent_from_disk, preserved not deleted): apollo-cena, apollo-classifieds (absorbed into apollo-adverts), apollo-pwa, apollo-runtime, apollo-shortcodes (absorbed into apollo-core), apollo-suppliers. Decide per plugin: build it, or retire the entry.
Chapter 13-runtime names apollo-runtime as owner; that plugin does not exist yet — ownership is nominal.
Layers L8_industry, L9_pwa and L12_runtime contain only absent plugins and are effectively empty.

RUNTIME SYNC IS UNVERIFIED. wp-content/apollo-registry.json (what the site reads, via APOLLO_REGISTRY_PATH in mu-plugins/apollo-brain.php) is a SEPARATE file from plugins/_inventory/apollo-registry.json (this build output). build.js deliberately does not write it. Nothing records when they were last synced. See 22-mu-plugins.json $registry_path_warning.

_dj_tracks v2: both write paths (REST + admin metabox) are consistent (apollo-core, apollo-djs, apollo-lux-panels). Front-end read path (apollo_dj_get_tracks() + out-now templates) still on v1 — see 20-meta-schemas.json known_gap.
dj.name and local.hero_image claim a metabox that apollo-lux-panels does not render (see 19-ssot-audit).
$doctor_description: build.js proves the chapters are structurally sound; doctor.js proves they are TRUE. Run `node doctor.js` before trusting any claim in here, and `node doctor.js --strict` in CI.

what_was_fixed: 15 plugin versions were stale vs disk (worst: apollo-templates 1.5.1 -> 1.6.24, apollo-core 6.3.0 -> 6.5.2). Synced from the disk docblock; each entry carries a $version_synced note.

apollo-adverts had a docblock/constant split (1.2.0 vs 1.2.2) — the exact bug class this registry warns about, because WP reads the docblock and cache-busting reads the constant. Docblock corrected to 1.2.2.
apollo-seed-runner existed on disk since 2026-08-29 with no registry entry. Entry created, placed in the new L14_tooling layer.
Plugin count disagreed three ways (map 47 / architecture 46 / summary 47 / actual 47). All now derive from the same count: 48.
architecture.$layers_absent_from_disk listed 4 of the 6 absent plugins. Now identical to absent_from_disk.
apollo-classifieds and apollo-shortcodes had registry entries but no architecture layer. Placed, with notes saying what absorbed them.
$mu_plugins documented 5 of 15 real MU files. Moved out of 14-routing into the new 22-mu-plugins chapter with all 15 documented.
apollo-error-handler was recorded at 'priority 999' (from docblock prose); the real add_action calls use PHP_INT_MAX.
apollo-route-setup flag was recorded as 2026.05.20.2; disk is 2026.07.03.2.
Every chapter carried a declared 'bytes' field that invalidates on each edit; 5 of 21 had already drifted. Field removed from all 21.
The monolith was stale vs its own chapters and apollo-registry-2.json was a known-stale mirror. Rebuilt; both are now byte-identical and round-trip clean.
